plugin.name: LLM Hub
plugin.description: Aggregate any number of model APIs behind one local endpoint, route by rules, and call it from local apps

autostart.label: Start gateway with Noctalia
autostart.description: Launch the local gateway daemon as soon as the plugin loads

stop_on_exit.label: Stop gateway on exit
stop_on_exit.description: Stop the daemon when Noctalia shuts down or the plugin is disabled

port.label: Listen port
port.description: Gateway port; if it is taken, the next free port is used

host.label: Listen address
host.description: Loopback only by default so local apps can reach it; 0.0.0.0 exposes it to your LAN

api_key.label: Local access key
api_key.description: Key local apps must send; leave empty to disable checking

poll_interval_ms.label: Refresh interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.description: How often the bar widget and console read gateway status

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Tabler icon shown in the bar, e.g. router, server, brain

show_text.label: Show text
show_text.description: Show request counts next to the bar glyph

show_requests.label: Show requests
show_requests.description: Include the total request count in the text

show_latency.label: Show latency
show_latency.description: Include the average latency in the text

bar.hint: Left click opens the console, right click copies the endpoint
bar.hint_body: Point your local app's base URL at this endpoint; any routed model name works

panel.title: LLM Hub
panel.not_running: The gateway is not running. Start it, or open settings to add your model APIs.

providers.title: Providers ({count})
providers.empty: No providers configured yet. Edit the config file, then hit Reload config.
providers.hint: Edit type, URL, API key and models right here; Save writes back to the config file and takes effect immediately while the gateway runs.
providers.type_hint: Upstream API flavour; switching resets the URL to that flavour's default
providers.url_hint: Provider API base URL, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com (no /v1)
providers.key_new: Paste the API key (${VAR} also works)
providers.models_hint: Comma separated; * = every model of this provider; empty = not routed
providers.add_hint: After adding, fill in URL, key and models to start using it
providers.added: Added {id}: fill in URL, key and models to activate it
providers.type_changed: Switched to {type}; URL reset to the new default, please review the models

rules.title: Routing rules
rules.fallback_on: falls back to the next candidate on failure

ask.title: Quick ask
ask.placeholder: Type a question, Enter to send (uses real routing)

route.title: Route dry run
route.placeholder: model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or fast
route.hint: Enter a model name (aliases and * wildcards work) to see the matched rule and provider
